scope: Independent review of frozen source authoring candidate/workflow, six browser adapter entries and parent wiring, focused tests and actual prepared desktop/mobile VM copies.

checks.detail: Exactly five semantic candidate kinds and six legal kind/capability pairs. Instance override and single layout use separate workflow state while retaining their common source operation. Unknown kinds and sibling capability claims refuse.

Each controller receives six source/editability context fields and its own capability key. Only override/fragment/structure lazily acquire world resource catalogs. Engine contracts import no GUI, HTTP, build adapter or tool process.

Model and chosen actor captured before source acquisition; source captured before catalog await; proposal and submitted DTO reject serializers/accessors and are detached before asynchronous ports. Owner checks use source/session/token plus latest attempt epochs.

Existing source/scene/hash/base/prohibited preview capabilities and each domain target matcher are preserved. Placement groups are read from sceneStructure.groups and sourceLocations.groups. Structure checks whole expanded identity/provenance, permits unused edits and the removed opener to be absent.

A returned own data-property valid preview UUID is captured even for stale/malformed responses and released in finally. Release is best effort; invalid or getter IDs are not promoted to release authority.

Source write ports receive current guards, successful source-token advancement is accepted only for the original owner, and completion requires the identical result plus full canonical proposal. Pending receipts are private, single-use, reset on reopen/close and protected against overlapping apply attempts.

Parent getState binds source path, selected recipe, preview/session and the original busy gates; it does not bind backend identity, latest build, artifact snapshot or runtime observation. A backend identity change alone does not grant or revoke source ownership.

retainedInitialFailure.reason: New test expected projection default size [40,50]; the immutable golden projection declares [80,60]. Corrected only the new fixture assertion. Candidate product source did not change.

boundaries: User approval and raw form signatures remain in the six established UI controllers; this extraction does not create a common UI state machine or grant approval from an engine receipt.

The injected source apply port still recomputes the exact domain patch and rechecks current ownership immediately before the in-memory editor write. Ordinary Save and external-file conflict handling remain host responsibilities.

Caller-supplied sourceRevision is computed from a captured candidate by the workflow digest port. The synchronous candidate validator does not perform hashing or independently grant source-write authority.
The previous busy/running and preview/source-writability gates are retained. This round does not authorize editing through an active source-owner or running-job conflict.
Temporary preview release remains best effort. Malformed or UUID-less responses are refused and are never converted into arbitrary release paths.
Standard VM and prepared copies verify portable contracts and packaging bytes, not hostile-code isolation, an installed desktop application, Android device acceptance or execution-engine acceptance.
